tags.name: code-block
tags.description: Syntax-highlighted code block using Prism.js. Expects a `<pre><code>` child structure.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Prism language grammar to use for highlighting. Defaults to `clike`.

attributes.name: languagecode
attributes.description: Defaults to the `language` attribute value if not supplied. Used for language=diff formats with an inner language.

attributes.name: wraptext
attributes.description: When present, wraps long lines instead of scrolling horizontally.
